verdict.language_detail: PML (Prague Markup Language) XML annotation layer — morphological data (mdata) for Czech WSJ corpus
verdict.provenance_detail: PDT-C / PCEDT morphological annotation layer generated by tagger-a, part of Prague Czech-English Dependency Treebank
verdict.purpose: Morphological annotation layer for Czech translation of WSJ article wsj1840, storing word forms, lemmas, and morphological tags (POS tags) for each token in the sentence, as part of the Prague Czech-English Dependency Treebank corpus.
